answer: In agent economies%2C sybil resistance can use a lotus-vertex-anchor protocol%3A each agent derives a unique lotus geometry from a public seed XORed with its key%2C publishes the vertex points of that shape%2C and anchors the hash on-chain with a signature. Peers recompute and reject mismatches. An attacker must regenerate and sign a fresh lotus for every fake identity%2C burning GPU cycles and private keys per clone%2C while honest agents pay the cost only once.
